messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Review and Decision-Making" as it appears in the following examples.
['I seek your consent to present you as the next of kin of the deceased, so that the proceeds of this account valued at $27million U. Sdollars can be paid to your account and then you and me can share the money.', 'Kindly reply me stating your interest, and I shall furnish you with the details and necessary procedures with which to make the transfer progress.', 'If this business proposition offends your moral values, do accept my apology but if not, then contact me at once to indicate your interest, by giving me your telephone number, fax number and your address.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
